If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, read
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/athiwatc/formless/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
before opening a public issue. Do not post vulnerability details here.

Before submitting, run `formless bug-report` and attach the
`formless-bug-report-*.md` file it creates. Read the report before attaching
it: it attempts to redact secrets, but redaction is not a reason to share
credentials. **Do not paste API keys, access tokens, passwords, pairing links,
or other secrets into this issue.** Remove any sensitive information from the
report before uploading it.
